subject_definitions: <Subject 1> A young Asian female martial artist (S1), approx. 20 years old, with a high black ponytail, wearing a layered grey-blue translucent Hanfu robe, dark trousers, and leather boots. She carries a long sword on her back. Her expression is initially stoic and cold.
<Subject 2> A vintage Chinese "28-style" bicycle from the 1980s/90s, featuring a rusted black steel frame, a large front basket, thick tires, and a prominent crossbar. It looks heavy and worn.
<Picture 1> The provided character sheet serves as the visual identity for <Subject 1>.

summary: [reference generation] The target video is a humorous, high-contrast scene where <Subject 1> rides <Subject 2> down a steep grassy hill. The video transitions from a wide action shot to a close-up of her panicked, exaggerated facial expression, accompanied by a funny Chinese monologue about the lack of brakes.

retention_analysis: <Subject 1> (appears in [Shot 1], [Shot 2], [Shot 3]): fully_preserved - The character's facial features, hairstyle, and Hanfu costume are strictly maintained from the reference image, but her posture changes from standing to riding.
<Subject 2> (appears in [Shot 1], [Shot 2]): fully_preserved - The vintage bicycle is generated based on the description of 80s/90s Chinese style.
<Picture 1> (used in [Shot 1] start): weak_reference - Used only for initial character identity; the pose is not retained as she is riding.

detailed_description: The video features a cinematic, high-contrast comedic style with realistic lighting and dynamic camera movement.

[Shot 1] The camera is positioned at a low angle on a steep, grassy hillside, looking up. <Subject 1> enters the frame from the top left, riding <Subject 2> (the vintage black bicycle) aggressively down the slope. Her Hanfu robes flutter violently in the wind. The bicycle wobbles slightly due to speed. The lighting is bright natural daylight with strong shadows. The sound of a rusty bicycle chain rattling and wind rushing is loud. The camera pans right to follow her movement at fast speed.

[Shot 2] At 00:03.500, the shot cuts to a medium close-up tracking shot from the side. <Subject 1> is now hunched over the handlebars of <Subject 2>, her eyes wide open in panic, losing her previous stoic demeanor. Her hair is messy. The background blurs due to motion. She is shouting. <Subject 1> (S1) says, <d>[Chinese] 师傅没教过我怎么刹车啊！</d> (Master never taught me how to brake!). The audio includes the creaking of the bike frame and her strained voice.

[Shot 3] At 00:07.000, the shot cuts to an extreme close-up of <Subject 1>'s face, shaking violently with the camera. Her eyes are bulging, and her mouth is open in a comedic scream of terror. The wind distorts her cheeks. <Subject 1> (S1) continues seamlessly across the cut, <d>[Chinese] 救命——这破车没有闸——！</d> (Help—this junk bike has no brakes—!). The sound of a loud, metallic screech (simulating failed brakes) mixes with her voice. No subtitles, captions, on-screen text, watermarks, or typography appear anywhere in the video.

overall_soundscape: The audio environment is dominated by the rushing wind, the rhythmic clanking of a loose bicycle chain, and the squeaking of old metal parts. As the speed increases, the wind noise becomes a roar. In the final shot, a sharp, dissonant metallic screech emphasizes the mechanical failure.
